caption_fb:
Follow Karen, Episode 1 (an example family)

Karen in Michigan knew one thing: Great-Grandpa Stanley came "from Poland." No village. No Polish.

Clue 1: his 1917 draft card. Born in "Rzepiennik, Austria." "Austria" meant Galicia, today's southern Poland. The search just got a lot smaller.

Clue 2: his 1910 passenger list. One column asks for the nearest relative left behind. The answer: his father, Jan.

It doesn't look like much. But that one first name is about to decide which village is the right one.

Episode 2 on December 15. Follow so you don't miss it.
